page: Microsoft Azure DC64eds_v6 is a virtual machine instance from the DCEDV6 family, built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and powered by Intel processors. Running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance features 64 dedicated virtual CPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The hardware configuration does not include any graphics processing units, making it a purely CPU-driven resource.

For local data requirements, the instance is equipped with 3780 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. It is also capable of utilizing Premium Storage for external disk attachments, providing high-throughput and low-latency disk performance. Network configurations for this instance do not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its high vCPU count, substantial memory capacity, and large local NVMe SSD storage, the DC64eds_v6 offers a balanced resource profile for enterprise workloads. The combination of dedicated compute resources and fast local storage makes it qualitatively cost-efficient for data-intensive operations that require high local disk throughput without the overhead of external storage arrays. This instance is suited for large-scale databases, memory-optimized applications, and enterprise-level transactional workloads.
